fact_text: Pakistan Oilfields declared a half-year dividend of PKR 7.7 per share, which the analyst said made its valuation look attractive on reserves.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan Oilfields looks well valued relative to its proven reserves, and that its P/E was attractive at the prevailing share price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: OGDC's newly found fields around Kohat in KP, including a fifth discovery, together produced about 14,000 barrels of oil per day, close to the 15,000 the analyst had expected.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: OGDC operates the Kohat-area fields with a 65% stake, while PPL holds a 30% stake and carries the risk alongside it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's crude imports could be rerouted through the Red Sea instead of the Strait of Hormuz, with talks with Saudi Arabia on this route.

fact_text: Qatar has halted its LNG exports from the Gulf, a supply shock that the analyst said is a development in the regional energy market.

fact_text: Pakistan cement dispatches in the eight months of FY26 reached about 34 to 35 million tonnes, up from about 31 to 32 million tonnes a year earlier, with export and local sales both rising.

fact_text: The analyst said cement dispatches track GDP and construction activity closely, so rising cement demand signals stronger growth and construction jobs drive much employment.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement, through its group entities, acquired 88% of Pioneer Cement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 05 March 2026 | Oil & Gas Sector Rally | OGDC, PPL, POL Dividend & Oil Price Impact' (YouTube, 2026-03-05)

fact_text: The analyst expects the Pioneer Cement acquisition to lift Maple Leaf's earnings capacity and capacity utilisation in FY26 and FY27.

fact_text: Fauji Cement is reported to be acquiring a stake in Attock Cement, a Northern-zone company that exports to the Gulf and Africa.

fact_text: The analyst said Maple Leaf and Fauji Cement trade at about 7 times a valuation multiple, which he found attractive given their earnings capacity.
